items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: But after that I went to, had the pleasure of playing with Humphrey and his band.

ctx.x: had to lecture. So I said, now the only thing you can do is to go on out there and act like you brothers, just had a fight in the family. So I made them shake hands and they went on out and finished the night without Sir Charles because he had gone on home.

They still talk about that in Geneva. They say do you remember that time? I say, yes I remember I always will. But after that I went to, had the pleasure of playing with Humphrey and his band. That was nice. Two or three times maybe four.
Yes, you made two albums with him too?
